skill.name: api-doc-generator
skill.description: Generate API documentation from code, including OpenAPI 3.0 specs, request examples, and Postman collection content.
skill.summary: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 API docs, request examples, and Postman collection content from supplied code details.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The only static finding was a high-entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Manual review found plain Markdown skill metadata and usage notes, with no obfuscation, prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or dangerous actions.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.13 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: Manual review found normal Markdown front matter and Chinese prose in SKILL.md, not binary, encrypted, or encoded content. No obfuscated payload appears in the 34-line file.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time keeping API docs, examples, and collections aligned with changing code. This skill helps generate OpenAPI 3.0 docs, request examples, and Postman collection content from supplied API details.
actual_capabilities: Generates OpenAPI 3.0 documentation from API code or route details supplied by the user.
Creates request examples for documented endpoints.
Produces Postman collection content for API testing workflows.
Supports API documentation work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
Runs through conversation instructions without bundled scripts or executables.
limitations: It does not include a dedicated parser or validation engine.
Output quality depends on the completeness of the supplied API code or endpoint details.
Generated OpenAPI and Postman content should be reviewed before production use.
Authentication, error models, and edge cases may need explicit user guidance.

use_cases.title: Document a New Service
use_cases.description: Generate initial OpenAPI 3.0 documentation and request examples from fresh backend routes.

use_cases.title: Package Client Handoff Materials
use_cases.description: Create readable API docs and Postman collection content for delivery to a client team.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team API Docs
use_cases.description: Convert scattered endpoint notes into a consistent documentation structure for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Document a Small API
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a few endpoints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate API documentation for these endpoints. Include OpenAPI 3.0 sections, request examples, and short descriptions: [paste routes].

prompt_templates.title: Add Request Examples
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving existing docs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these API docs and add clear request examples, response summaries, parameters, and required headers: [paste documentation].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Postman Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for API testing handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Postman collection content from these endpoints. Group requests by resource and include variables for base URL and tokens: [paste endpoints].

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Full API Spec
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for complete documentation review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this API documentation for accuracy, consistency, and OpenAPI 3.0 coverage. Flag missing schemas, errors, authentication details, and examples: [paste spec].

output_examples.input: A user provides login, profile, and logout endpoint details.
output: OpenAPI 3.0 sections are organized by authentication and user resources.
Each endpoint includes parameters, request examples, response summaries, and common error cases.
Postman collection guidance is prepared for immediate testing setup.

output_examples.input: A team shares partial notes for a billing API.
output: Endpoint descriptions are rewritten in a consistent style.
Missing authentication, pagination, and error behavior are called out for review.
Request examples are added for invoices, customers, and payment actions.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a client handoff package.
output: The API documentation is structured for non-author maintainers.
Postman collection content is grouped by workflow.
Review notes highlight assumptions that need confirmation.

best_practices: Provide route definitions, request bodies, response shapes, and authentication rules together.
Ask the assistant to list assumptions before treating generated docs as complete.
Validate generated OpenAPI and Postman content with your real API before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not paste incomplete endpoints and expect production-ready documentation.
Do not publish generated specs without checking authentication, errors, and data models.
Do not include secrets, private tokens, or live credentials in prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate OpenAPI 3.0 documentation, request examples, and Postman collection content from supplied API details.

faq.question: Does it inspect my repository automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill relies on code, routes, or endpoint details that you provide in the conversation.

faq.question: Can it create production-ready API specs?
faq.answer: It can create strong drafts, but generated specs should be validated against the real API before production use.

faq.question: Does it support Postman workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description states support for Postman collection content and request examples.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should I include credentials in prompts?
faq.answer: No. Use placeholders for tokens, passwords, and private URLs when requesting examples or collections.
